rule: A family is (head term from demand_intents.json, landing page; state hubs collapse to /states/{STATE}/). It qualifies if (a) a page in it has >= 2 impressions at position <= 15, or (b) it is in the site's top 5 families by 28-day impressions with >= 5 impressions at impression-weighted position <= 95. A qualifying family is strengthened on its landing page when the page's intent matches (state hubs: every state page with >= 10 family impressions); otherwise it records the reason.
